dataset.attribution: Synthetic-PII-Financial-Documents-North-America: A synthetic dataset for training language models to label and detect PII in domain specific formats. Watson, Meyer, Van Segbroeck, Grossman, Torbey, Mlocek, Greco; Gretel, 2024. https://huggingface.co/datasets/gretelai/synthetic_pii_finance_multilingual (Apache 2.0). Only aggregate counts derived from it are published here; no records.
dataset.name: gretel-pii-finance
notes: 27 gold spans in 8 documents end past the end of their text (19 of them `name`); they are dropped and counted in the report (gold_dropped_out_of_range).
409 pairs of gold spans overlap (mostly name/name and company/company, nested or crossing); each gold span is scored on its own.
Gold spans were labelled with the help of an NER library (GLiNER), filtered by an LLM judge and spot-checked by people; the card warns that missed and wrong labels remain.
Seven languages (English, Spanish, Swedish, German, Italian, Dutch, French); slices by language.

system.configuration: defaults (no custom recognisers, no context words added, no allow list)
